description: This week, we explore the role of AI in Communication. Article to annotate: Cheng, M., Lee, C., Khadpe, P., Yu, S., Han, D., & Jurafsky, D. (2026). Sycophantic AI decreases prosocial intentions and promotes dependence. Science, 391

This week, we explore the role of algorithms and AI in everyday life. Article to annotate: Zewail, A., Figueroa, A., Graham, J., & Atari, M. (2026). Moral stereotyping in large language models. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 123(10), e2519941123.

This week, we are looking at the digital surveillance in society. Article to annotate:  Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency (pp. 77-91). PMLR.

This week, we look at the future of communication, including the ethics and questions of sustainability of machine learning and AI. Article to annotate: Sharma, H. (2026). Testing medical AI by fabricating disease: an ethical analysis. Ethics, Medicine and Public Health, 34, 101310.

This week, we are looking at values in Machine Learning Models. Article to annotate:  Birhane, A., Kalluri, P., Card, D., Agnew, W., Dotan, R., & Bao, M. (2022, June). The values encoded in machine learning research. In Proceedings of the 2022 ACM conference on fairness, accountability, and transparency (pp. 173-184)
